issue.title: Overlay-dock the prompt bar so <space> reveals within the 60 ms key-to-paint target

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The sase-1ex plan lists overlay-docking the prompt bar as an explicit non-goal, because it changes UX: the bar would cover content instead of pushing the layout. The plan requires recording it as a follow-up when the space target is missed (space-hot-spare phase, Bench step). It needs its own design and UX decision, so it does not belong in the epic's landing.

issue.creation_reason: Required follow-up from epic sase-1ex: the <space> target (p95 <= 60 ms) was missed even with the hot spare, and the plan names overlay docking as the remaining, UX-changing lever.
